threat_evidence_ladder.label: Theoretical threat
threat_evidence_ladder.test: Technically possible, little evidence of current exploitation.

threat_evidence_ladder.label: Known threat activity
threat_evidence_ladder.test: Related malware, techniques or adversary activity observed somewhere.

threat_evidence_ladder.label: Relevant active campaigns
threat_evidence_ladder.test: Organizations with similar technologies or characteristics are being targeted.

threat_evidence_ladder.label: Confirmed exploitation of relevant technology
threat_evidence_ladder.test: KEV listing, or high EPSS, for a technology the organization is confirmed to operate.

threat_evidence_ladder.label: Direct organizational evidence
threat_evidence_ladder.test: Matching malicious activity found in the organization's own telemetry.
threat_evidence_ladder.caution: At this rung the situation is usually an incident, not a prospective risk. Invoke incident response first; risk assessment of it becomes a post-incident exercise.

constraints.cvss: Base score only. Exploitation evidence is routed to Pb(psi,A), never to CVSS Threat metrics, to avoid double counting in a product (C2).
constraints.exposure_gate: No parameter uplift without organizational evidence of exposure (C4).
constraints.calculation_path: Offline and deterministic. This snapshot is the only intelligence input (C1).
